title: GitLab Orbit Versions
description: Schema for config/versions.yaml: pinned versions and vendored dependencies.

schema.description: Graph schema version; prefixes every versioned ClickHouse table.

raw_output_format.description: Response envelope version of the raw (JSON) formatter (semver).

toon_output_format.description: Version of the TOON encoding of the raw graph response (semver).

vendored.description: Vendored dependencies with sub-pins, artifact locations, and vendor/check scripts.

vendored_dependency.description: A vendored upstream dependency with its version pin, artifact location, and scripts.

version.description: Primary version pin (tag, SHA, or semver).

vendor_dir.description: Repository-relative path where vendored artifacts live.

vendor_script.description: Script that regenerates artifacts from pins. Must live under scripts/vendored/.

check_script.description: Read-only script that validates artifacts match pins. Must live under scripts/vendored/.

extensions.description: Named sub-dependencies (e.g. DuckDB extensions) with source and binary pins.

pins.description: Flat key-value sub-pins (e.g. Iglu schema name to version).

extension.description: A vendored extension with optional source archive and per-platform binary pins.

source_revision.description: Git commit SHA of the upstream extension source.

source_archive_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the vendored source archive.

binaries.description: Per-platform SHA-256 checksums of pre-built extension binaries.
